params.name: project_identifier
params.description: The project identifier: either project ID or project name.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Inclusive lower bound on trace start time (ISO 8601)

params.name: end_time
params.description: Exclusive upper bound on trace start time (ISO 8601)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of traces to return

params.name: include_spans
params.description: If true, include full span details for each trace. This significantly increases response size and query latency, especially with large page sizes. Prefer fetching spans lazily for individual traces when possible.

params.name: session_identifier
params.description: List of session identifiers to filter traces by. Each value can be either a session_id string or a session GlobalID. Only traces belonging to the specified sessions will be returned.

items.docs: Add a note annotation to a trace. By default each call appends a new note with an auto-generated UUIDv4 identifier, so multiple notes accumulate on the same trace. Callers may supply a non-empty `identifier` to upsert on (trace_id, name='note', identifier) — repeated calls with the same identifier overwrite the existing note, matching the semantics of structured annotations.

params.name: trace_identifier
params.description: The trace identifier: either a relay GlobalID or OpenTelemetry trace_id

items.docs:
Delete an entire trace by its identifier. The identifier can be either:
1. A Relay node ID (base64-encoded)
2. An OpenTelemetry trace_id (hex string)

This will permanently remove all spans in the trace and their associated data.
